title: What will Rakesh Tikait do in UP elections? Telling Saurabh Shukla

The biggest question is that now there is a discussion that the farmer movement has disappeared from the media and social media. Farmer leader Rakesh Tikait with us to talk about this. Let us know from these whether the peasant movement is weakened?  About Us: NDTV India is a 24-his news channel. asr.full_text: We are at the Ghazipur border, which is the border of Delhi where farmers have been on strike for more than 6 months. The biggest question is that there is a lot of discussion going on that farmers' protest has disappeared from the media and social media. Rakesh Tikait is with us. He is not required to introduce himself. Rakesh ji, has the farmer's movement become weak? No. The movement is increasing as the corona virus is increasing. Has the corona virus ended in this country? If the corona virus has ended, people call the, people are waiting for it. People of the press say that the crowd has increased. So you are not calling a big event because the crowd hasn't increased? We are calling two-fold. On 26th, the governor will march in the entire state. He will be given a gift and will be given a chance to meet him. On 26th, the governor will march there. They will be given the permission and they will be met. All the governors in the country? Governor and L.G. will go there. Will you go to Delhi? Yes, we will go to Delhi. Will you go by car or by bus? No, we will go by car. The Delhi committee will go. So there is no need to march? No, there is no need to march. The march will come here on 26th. And two districts will come here on 26th. Two districts will have their own tech tours and then different people will come. The march will continue like this. Two districts will have tech tours in Sauranpur and Mujaffarnagar. They will come on 24th, 25th and 26th. Mr. Saqib, earlier you were calling out for the Kisan Andolan People were mobilized But now the farmers are calm Yes, they are calm Because the issue has been going on for 3 years The whole army fought for 3 years Till 2024 Yes, till 2024 Till 2024 So Modi ji is not in the mood No, he is that in 2024, the farmers will come to a stand where they will either agree or go to the government? No, the Indian government will take back these laws in 2024. After the elections? Whatever it takes, it will happen. Rakesh ji, you will give a small program on 26th, you are doing it. Yes, I are doing it. You are from Uttar Pradesh. Even though you are a farmer. You will be in Uttar Pradesh next year. In the election. We all have seen what happened in the farmers' movement. The mismanagement. Even during corona, there was mismanagement in Uttar Pradesh. We saw floating corpses in the river Ganges. We saw big graves on the banks of the river Ganges. People died on the roads. Rakesh ji, what will you do in the Uttar Pradesh elections? The current government is under BJP's control and Yogi ji is not in favor of farmers' protest. The police and the PHC have put you here to take you in. What will you do? The people will do it themselves. They know that I am in the village. They are waiting for the time when they will come to the village. They are waiting for the village to come. BJP politicians have to go to the village. They will vote in the village. They are waiting for the village to come. We will question them. We will answer their questions. Are you saying that farmers, especially in Uttar Pradesh, when BJP politicians go to ask vote in Uttar Pradesh will not be allowed to enter the election? No, they will ask questions. They will ask questions and we will know when they go. What will farmers do? For example, Haryana has announced that they will have to defeat BJP in the next election. They will tell people that BJP should not be voted by them, it is a farmer's opposition government. What else will we do? Will we make them win more votes? We will make them win, but they will not vote in Uttar Pradesh. They will do this. Will you also do it by going against them? Who else will do it? We will also do it against them. BJP will not vote, give it to someone else. Because you went to West Bengal, you also went to Bengal. BJP lost there. They lost. The medicine worked They used the right medicines there They got relief from that What will you do in Uttar Pradesh? They will give medicines They will get relief in Uttar Pradesh too They have a 3 year course They have a 3 year course They will get relief in 3 years Rakesh ji, tell us It is a 3 year course but It is said that UP elections are semi-final In 2017 BJP won the UPS elections in UDP while in 2020 it won the BDS elections but what are the chances? Government doesn't know about each and every one of them, when there was district panchayat, 606 seats were won by government, 3050 seats, and he is now being elected as the executive, I don't understand the details, how this number is made, this is like the police department being an agent of BJP and at gunpoint, taking the candidate down, and giving him vote, this is how it works, ...they might become BJP agents and continue to take candidates away who do not have guns. What will be your position in Rakesh Tika in 2022? I'll hold a meeting with the panchayats, we'll run as soon as this starts. We'll run in the panchayats? Yes. How will they react? People will say that electricity prices of the country. I.e. panchayat and Government What type of administration? People will say that electricity costs are high in the entire country and food in Ghana has also increased the rates of Ghana didn't increase for the past 4 years How is the situation of wheat and potato farm? they will tell you their own story What are the medical facilities the country at your gates.. ..there is no one in Government or any politician, what you've told us, we know what's happening.. What if Rakesh does it then? He'll be doing it with the government.. Rakesh, if you come tomorrow and he orders a few people from up north to join in elections.. ..then what will he ask for? He just said to Rakesh Ji to join his party and to fight for elections What will Rakesh Ji do? We talked to the Uttar Pradesh elections yesterday We will see what will Priyanka Gandhi, Akhilesh Adam, Jain Chowdhary do What will Rakesh Ji do in the face of all these farmers? Now all they will say is join your protest and we will plant tents here Then I will accept the farmers' sympathy Tents will have to be placed to them in the streets They won't plant the tent and have no other party Rakesh says to fight for the us, then what will they say? No one will say we are fighting elections, I am not ready. I'll try to get them involved. Oh so they won't fight elections. No, they won't fight elections. Farmers will fight elections Rajeshji, you have an influence on the country, I mean your family and tickets on these roads of North-East. If the public says they will not ask for their ticket then will they fight? The Western UP is being affected but your family will be affected instead of your country. People will demand that we should fight the election of Rakesh Chyk. No people will only fight by what he says So, we will not fight the election? No, we are not fighting the electoral election But, are you campaigning against BJP? How can we fight against them, if this is our only battle? We are not making our own deal for the result. Last question, in which direction will the protest go in. You are saying the three years preparation is still going in. Whether it is the singoo or tikri borders or the incitement of sexual harassment with women... And there are some other criminal incidents too. So do you think that this protest has gone a long way.... And so are some other events in that? They are press, the government and the press. If a Home Minister from Haryana becomes an SHO or Home Minister of India, he will report the matter to the IOC and the authorities and then that person was taken for scruple and this will only lead to a terrible crime. This matter was not done at a sexual & sexual violence crime. We have no idea how the police will react if the police is there. Can someone put on a mask and show their footage? They have set a tent to burn. The farmers hung blankets on the roof. There is no sign of the police there. Do you think that nothing nothing like that? What do we look like? We are farmers not they! What will happen when there is another big call? How do we know? They will decide, from farming camp We have 4 Lakhs tractor here we should stop the bike and leave Should we start? I told you it will start Can you see Rakhine Swigati coming here? This tractor can load up without any other man If it is fully loaded, it can handle the vehicle We always join us as members of the DGP. You may say there are no red lights going off because there is a Red light. Go! Go! You are a member of the Parliament. Go! Go! There are 4 lakh contractors here as a member of the government as well as 25 lakh citizens here. And they come here everyday on 26th August. You may remember this Delhi. Delhi means Government? Yes. And what kind of government is it? Delhi means, this is the father government . Rakesh Trikyat answers very well in his own manner. All the contractors are standing answers Rakesh Diqeyat gave in his own way. All tractors and facilities are open. But all he did was keep in mind that in future elections Rakesh Diqeyat will not fight and that he will get a campaign from BJP. Farmers are waiting with their tractors. The governor will give a small performance and provide a small show for it. And we exactly support their demand. But for the time being, it has been Rakesh Tiket's words. Thank you very much, Sir. Thank you.
